signin.title: Sign in
signin.subtitle: Welcome back. Pick up your reviews where you left off.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Start reviewing specs with comments that keep their place.

sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

oauthErrors.github_failed: GitHub sign-in didn't complete. Please try again.
oauthErrors.github_no_verified_email: Your GitHub account has no verified email. Verify one on GitHub, or sign in with a password.

errors.validation: Please check the form and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong reaching the server. Please try again.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we’ll send you a reset link. If you use GitHub, continue with GitHub on the sign-in page.
forgot.success: If this email has a password account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a password with at least 8 characters.
reset.success: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalid: This reset link is invalid or expired. Request a new link below.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.subtitle: We sent a welcome email to {email}. Follow its confirmation link to activate your account. Check your spam folder if it hasn’t arrived.
verify.sent: Confirmation email requested. Check your inbox.
verify.checkAgain: If you have confirmed your email, you’ll continue automatically. Otherwise, open the link in your inbox, then try again.
verify.signOut: Sign out and use another account
verify.invalid: This confirmation link is invalid or expired. Sign in and request a new email.
verify.signIn: Sign in to request a new confirmation email.
verify.confirmed: Your email is confirmed. Sign in to start reviewing.
